verdict_text:
NO

The script drops head index 6, but the specification requires removing head 5 (spec: "remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)"). This makes `DROP_HEAD = 6` violate Required Result clauses 1–3, since the kept row/column ranges will differ from the required `0..3839, 4608..6143` (rows) and `0..1279, 1536..2047` (columns) — dropping head 6 keeps rows/cols including head 5's block and excludes head 6's block instead. Although the shape assertions (5376, 2048 / 5376 / 2048, 1792) will still pass since they only check sizes, the actual bit-exact contents will not match the hidden reference per the Grading clause. This is a wrong-head-index bug, not a layout/order bug.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
